# Theory of Becoming: full foundational target

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`theory-of-becoming-foundation` · **open** · target · F01 · [record](theory-of-becoming-foundation.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Target: the deductive necessity of Becoming as a whole, with no added substantive axiom: formally, every central law over every law of exchange; philosophically, its determinations as moments of one unfolding; generation, persistence, degeneration, dissolution, life, evolution, evaluation within it.

<a id="progress--已接通"></a>
## Progress

1. Coherent inclusion: pooling processes that share interpretations keeps exactly the union of their histories iff it is closed under joining at the shared boundary; a checked coherence constraint, not the universal constitutive warrant. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/GROUNDING-INFERENCE-AND-PRESENTATION.md#16-inclusive-becoming-and-coherent-continuation)
2. Operative relations and causal order: after a primary quantum-process comparison, the candidate distinguishes operative constitution from a definite causal order at every interface; the existing trace theorems keep their scope. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/GROUNDING-INFERENCE-AND-PRESENTATION.md#17-operative-relations-without-a-presupposed-global-order)
3. Local loss in a retained whole: a checked restricted control calculation (quantum inputs supplied) derives local loss through a reversible wider interaction, separating reduced access from retained joint relations; not universal grounding. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/GROUNDING-INFERENCE-AND-PRESENTATION.md#18-a-checked-operative-loss-and-a-retained-whole)
4. Whole and manifold: following Ren’s correction, the necessity target is Becoming as a whole, with generativity within its manifold; the completion audit no longer gates on universal generativity. [study](../../history/BECOMING-FOUNDATION.md#whole-and-manifold)
5. From inclusion to relation: the direct whole-inclusion argument is assessed and still lacks the passage to relational constitution; a primary Hegel comparison separates a category of becoming from a causal mechanism. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/GROUNDING-INFERENCE-AND-PRESENTATION.md#19-the-whole-deduction-and-the-passage-from-inclusion-to-relation)
6. Spine evidence: each audit row cites the spine’s laws of the whole, its parts carved by premises (seven shown met by some worlds and not others, eight shown independent) and countermodels, locating the remainder without discharging it. [study](../../history/BECOMING-FOUNDATION.md#5-completion-audit-and-next-central-inference)
7. Living significance is no adopted axiom: in the theory without the condition it is a condition of the laws that use it, with its definition and characterizations kept; the reading of positive relevance is an open reading. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/mirror/BECOMING-RENEWAL-READING/067.md#67-折叠-g0p51)
8. Relation first: laws stated on the levels alone, the premises read off the exchange (premises-read-off-the-exchange) and readings in context forming one world (unity-of-readings); the representation's commitments remain. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/mirror/BECOMING-RENEWAL-READING/125.md#125-从关系开始的重建只用水平的规律从交换读出的前提语境中的读法becomingnoveltybecomingreadingbecomingreadings)
9. The theory asserts no axiom: that everything is significant is only the condition of the conditional section, under which living significance follows; the step of invariance remains to be stated. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/mirror/BECOMING-RENEWAL-READING/162.md#162-第二部分折叠进第一部分一个条件小节p128)
10. One root: every world is a run of the law its webs and exchanges show (worlds-are-runs, largely by definition), frontier laws stated on two-act worlds; the families meet by correspondence, 1,019 of 7,214 theorems apart at landing. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/mirror/BECOMING-RENEWAL-READING/165.md#165-一个根每个基都读作运行前沿陈述在两种作为的世界上p130)
11. Premises read off one exchange (E1): of the eight World premises, five are readings (the four tying premises, and the census under enclosure, never refuted without it) and three, dissipation, embodiment and bounded transmission, are states of the law of exchange, as closure and enclosure are; the necessary content of the whole cannot include those three. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/mirror/BECOMING-RENEWAL-READING/197.md#197-which-remaining-premises-a-reading-of-the-exchange-settles-e1)
12. Formal part restated with approval: every central law of the spine stated over every law, or relation, of exchange, each World premise a reading of the exchange or a state of the law, the families joined by definition. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/mirror/BECOMING-RENEWAL-READING/218.md#218-r25-the-twentieth-reviews-step-1-docs-now)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- Ren authorizes work toward completion; the monist relational method guides reconstruction and must disclose its own role. Existing conditional achievements and independent scopes remain intact.

**Not required by this target:**

- Not every becoming need be generative: the failure of a particular generative mode is not by itself a counterexample to Becoming.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- The checked results reused here do not by themselves supply the deduction of the whole claim.
- Neither inclusive naming nor universalizing one generative mode supplies the whole deduction; particular mechanisms explain modes within Becoming.
- Ren’s necessity claim is retained as the target without being installed as an axiom, and no impossibility claim is made.
- The formal part, complete, would not settle the philosophical part, and it reaches a becoming only where that becoming has a law of exchange with finite courses (the scope of representation).
- **Counterexample:** A pooled representation can invent unsupported continuations. Its repair and actual context change retain genuine terminality without refuting the full account. [source](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/GROUNDING-INFERENCE-AND-PRESENTATION.md)
- **Counterexample:** The primary quantum-switch comparison challenges promotion to definite causal order at every native operational interface. It does not refute temporal implementation or the existing trace theorems. [source](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/GROUNDING-INFERENCE-AND-PRESENTATION.md)

<a id="evidence--证据"></a>
## Evidence

Reused evidence: the checked finite-history coherence result and the checked 27-theorem restricted control calculation, with receipts in their records; the operational-order assessment against a primary quantum-process source; and the Becoming spine’s checked laws, parts and countermodels, cited in each row of the completion audit. The whole-deduction assessment rests on primary Hegel passages and author counterreview. This record adds no mathematical proof.

Canonical source: [BECOMING-FOUNDATION.md](../../history/BECOMING-FOUNDATION.md)

<a id="next--下一步"></a>
## Next

Formal part: every central law of the spine (K1) stated over every law of exchange, as premises-read-off-the-exchange and premises-that-are-states-of-the-law do for the World premises, the families joined by definition (worlds-are-runs). Philosophical part: the whole relationally constituted, not only consistently stated.

<details><summary>Correspondence, dependencies, sources and history</summary>

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

The whole deduction must warrant relational unity and differentiation, including its own articulation. Inclusive scope, established constitutive relations and particular operative mechanisms have distinct inferential roles within the same unfolding; no universally productive successor or complete causal connectivity is presumed.

<a id="dependencies--依赖"></a>
### Dependencies

- **interpretive**: [becoming-context-coherence](becoming-context-coherence.md). Supplies a checked coherence constraint on inclusive histories, not the universal constitutive warrant.
- **interpretive**: [control-coherence-loss](control-coherence-loss.md). Provides a checked operative state interface in which local loss arises through a reversible wider interaction; supports the distinction between reduced access and retained joint relations, not universal grounding.
- related, not a proved adapter: [endpoint-loss-and-return](endpoint-loss-and-return.md). Concurrent structural research retains endpoint loss and configuration-identity scope; no new physical composition is claimed.
- related, not a proved adapter: [derived-history-law-exactness](derived-history-law-exactness.md). Credits the derived local law at its supplied-history scope; does not infer universal operational coverage from exact finite-word feasibility.
- related, not a proved adapter: [space-and-its-parts](space-and-its-parts.md). On the Becoming spine, laws with no premise hold of every world as the spine represents worlds, and premises carve parts, seven of which are shown met by some worlds and not by others, and eight of which, replacing the reserve with a census and bounded transmission, are shown independent. This locates the whole claim's substantive remainder without discharging it.
- related, not a proved adapter: [coming-and-ceasing-keep-pace](coming-and-ceasing-keep-pace.md). Arising and ceasing, forming and dissolving, and coming to stand and ceasing to stand are one change, coming to be and ceasing to be, read three ways; in a finite family whose determinations are decided, coming to be and ceasing to be recur together, with no premise about the unfolding.
- related, not a proved adapter: [premises-read-off-the-exchange](premises-read-off-the-exchange.md). The premises read off the exchange: the world with the rest counted balances.
- related, not a proved adapter: [unity-of-readings](unity-of-readings.md). Readings in context make one world; context-free description exists just where they glue.
- related, not a proved adapter: [worlds-are-runs](worlds-are-runs.md). A world is exactly a run of the law it shows; the correspondence holds largely by unfolding definitions.
- related, not a proved adapter: [continuation-condition-yields-living-significance](continuation-condition-yields-living-significance.md). Under the condition that everything is significant, living significance follows; the theory does not assert the condition.
- related, not a proved adapter: [premises-that-are-states-of-the-law](premises-that-are-states-of-the-law.md). Where becoming is contingent in the law: dissipation, embodiment and bounded transmission are met by some laws of exchange and failed by others, with the readings fixed.
- related, not a proved adapter: [census-read-off-the-exchange](census-read-off-the-exchange.md). The census is a reading of the exchange under enclosure.
- related, not a proved adapter: [conditional-foundation-assessment](conditional-foundation-assessment.md). Credits completed conditional mechanisms and the original five-condition assessment without substituting them for the stronger target.
